concept: Heart of the Grove: Mossprout's definitive signature Haven, resolved around an ancient magical tree.
floor: Deep forest moss with an open front-center clearing and a narrow pond around the rear roots.
main_structure: The same rear-center tree is now one ancient magical tree with a smooth broad trunk, root hollow, and five to seven large cloud-like foliage masses.
rear_props: the resolved rounded resting nook at rear-left
a few oversized restrained luminous plants around the pond
lighting: soft woodland daylight with restrained mint magic and warm amber lanterns
